answer: The honest maker pays once, in hours at the bench; the liar pays three times, in hours, in coin, and in risk. Proof of printer press via stationers company sets the price: a press the stationers company licenses only after the printer pulls a sheet he actually set. The quartz is the first payment, the bridge the second, and the summit the third, and the three together come to 19 days a cheat cannot spare, for work he never did.
